


```{r display blood results for pTau 217 from the kuadrc cohort, ft.align="left"}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr params$kuadrc_ptau217
#| results: asis

# pTau217 on the Simoa
# < 0.4 Not Elevated --  AD pathology not indicated”
# ≥ 0.4 to < 0.63  Indeterminant --  AD pathology possible”
# ≥ 0.63 Elevated --  AD pathology likely”

# pTau217/AB42 on the Lumipulse
# < 0.00371 Not Elevated --  AD pathology not indicated”
# ≥ 0.00371 to < 0.00738  Indeterminant --  AD pathology possible”
# ≥ 0.00738 Elevated --  AD pathology likely”

cutoffs <- tibble::tribble(
  ~assay_used         , ~low    , ~high   ,
  "pTau217"           , 0.4     , 0.63    ,
  "pTau217/A\u03B242" , 0.00371 , 0.00738
)

fq("sections/blood/latex/proteins.tex", type = "input")

assays <- unique(ptau$assay_used)

ptau_footer <- paste(
  "All",
  paste0(assays, collapse = " and "),
  "measures are in pg/ml."
)

if (length(assays) == 2) {
  ptau_footer <- paste(
    ptau_footer,
    "A new blood pTau217/A\u03B24242 assay was added in May 2026",
    "and is not comparable with previous pTau217 results."
  )
}

ptau_df <- ptau |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    dplyr::desc(as.Date(fluid_collection_date, format = "%m/%d/%Y"))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(cutoffs, by = "assay_used") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = dplyr::case_when(
      analyte_value < low ~ "Not Elevated",
      analyte_value >= low & analyte_value < high ~ "Indeterminant",
      analyte_value >= high ~ "Elevated"
    ),
    analyte_value = round(analyte_value, 4),
    interpretation = factor(
      category,
      levels = c("Not Elevated", "Indeterminant", "Elevated"),
      labels = c(
        "Not Elevated: Alzheimer's disease pathology not indicated",
        "Indeterminant: Alzheimer's disease pathology possible",
        "Elevated: Alzheimer's disease pathology likely"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  # fmt: skip
  dplyr::select(fluid_collection_date, assay_used, analyte_value, interpretation)

BRIDGE21::flex_table(
  ptau_df,
  col_labels = c("Date", "Method", "Value", "Interpretation"),
  widths = c(0.75, 1, 0.75, 4.1),
  footers = ptau_footer
)

fq("sections/blood/latex/after-tau.tex", type = "input")

fq(type = "newpage")
```
